d1: Changing segment length and overlap makes tone separation, spectral width, nominal/effective averages, and seeded CV cross independent boundaries that a static spectrum cannot expose.

implementation.initial_state: Balanced edge: M=2048, periodic Hann, 50% overlap; separated and empirical CV=0.267121, so both targets pass.

Balanced edge: M=2048, 50% overlap; separated, CV=0.267121

implementation.guided_task: Increase M from Short blur until the 0.04-cycle/sample pair separates, continue until empirical CV fails, then return to a simultaneous pass and compare overlap without treating K as independent evidence.
implementation.determinism: No runtime randomness, timer, network, or worker. The browser replays the frozen 96-trial empirical CV table and computes the exact deterministic frame-mean tone spectrum synchronously.
implementation.honesty_boundary: Manual combinations absent from the frozen study display predicted 1/sqrt(K_eff) but no empirical verdict; only frozen 96-trial rows may pass the empirical-CV target.
implementation.scaling: Two-sided PSD per cycles/sample; window-power normalization U=sum|w[n]|^2; 10log10(S/1) dB; noise-only CV calibration at f=0.3125.
implementation.accessibility: Native kit buttons and indexed range slider; 44px control heights; SVG has a complete text alternative; chart uses labels/dashes in addition to color; narrow layouts use an internal horizontal scroller.
